subject: [Invite] Encord AI Leaders Dinner @ Spruce, SF - Oct 30th
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our Co-Founder, [SENDER], is hosting a private dinner in SF on Thursday, 30th
October (6:30-9:30pm) at Spruce, and we'd love for you to join.

The evening's theme is the multimodal shift in AI - how vision is
converging with language, robotics, and embodied systems. We're capping it
at ~30 guests, with CxOs and technical leaders from companies like Waymo,
Rivian, Thinking Machines Labs and more.

For context, Encord is a ML data layer scale-up ($50M Series B - YC,
Next47, CRV) helping teams align their data through curation, annotation,
and model evaluation.

Would be great to have you in the room. Please let me know if you're
interested and I'll share the invite.

subject: [COMPANY] <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

Cool AI models you're building at [COMPANY] for healthy living! I imagine
your team's using in-house or open-source tools for prepping training data.
Reaching out since I work with founders from Twelve Labs, Synthesia, and
Physical Intelligence to help their teams move faster while cutting tooling
costs as they scale.

Quick context: Encord (YC W21, Series B) streamlines data development for
multimodal AI (text, audio, image, video) - curation, annotation, QA, and
model evaluation in one place. So teams spend less time jumping across
tools and more time improving products. We just released a new, open-source
dataset with 107 million groups of images, videos, text, audio, and 3D
point clouds, you can see the dataset here
<[LINK]>
.

Happy to show how others are saving months of dev times and costs - would
you be open to a quick chat Tue to Thu next week? I'm flexible morning
times PT.
